chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: St. Louis, Chicago and the end of Bill Bailey's Troubadours
summary: The brothers join Bailey's company in St. Louis, play Illinois towns and Chicago, then are stranded in South Bend.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: When you left Kansas City, you went from there to Chicago?
Well, yeah...well, no, I went from there to St. Louis, and that's where we joined the, uh...Bill Bailey Troubadours. They start from St. Louis
And then you were playing again?
Yeah, we were doing our act then.
And how long were you in St. Louis?
Oh, about a week or two. We left with the show. See? We just went there for rehearsal, then get out.

Oh, we played all around, a lot of towns in Illinois, I think--St. Joe...and I can't remember...uh...all them little towns, you know, and then went on in to Chicago, and we was supposed to go on up to Elkhart, Indiana, and all around in...and we went to South Bend, and that's where the manager run off and left ever'body stranded. So that ended the Bill Bailey Troubadours, and that's where that I met the woman that was called...what was her name? Smith? The first one?
